c: Mannajja releases a pulsing wave of sparkling purple particles outwards from the player in the shape of five concentric circles similar to a sound wave. The particles are positioned relative to the player in a vertical column around them, and follow their movement. The Mannajja covers a much wider

Enemies hit by the Mannajja are slowed down permanently. If the enemy is not immune to debuffs, each hit reduces the Movement Speed of the affected enemy by an additional 5%, until it reaches a minimum of 20% of their original speed after 16 hits. The slow effect stacks multiplicatively with other Movement Speed modifications.

The Mannajja has a 1 second Hitbox Delay, meaning that the same enemy cannot be hit more often than once every second by the same pulse. However, because all active delays are reset simultaneously as soon as any one elapses, some enemies may get hit more often.
- Allows the Mannajja to emit special damaging zones. These zones take the form of several planets orbiting around a point.
With Limit Break, the Mannajja can be further leveled up.
See Combos for a list of all item interactions.
